title: Service carries the seeker across
summary: Through the True Guru, devotion and service become the crossing into union. Choose settlement before more motion.
lifeApplication: When the mind wants more motion, choose one act of devotion or service that returns you to the path you already know.

source.shortMeaning: Through the True Guru, devotion and service become the crossing into union.
source.lifeApplication: Let devotion become concrete before restlessness turns into one more search for novelty.

evidence.coreClaim: Through the True Guru, devotion and service become the crossing into union.
evidence.turn: Roaming ends when the Guru reveals the deeper union.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the mind wants more motion, choose one act of devotion or service that returns you to the path you already know.
